text:
maria.g: quick check — prepping 'aurora-v2' for ingestion. weights are at s3://redwood-models/ingest/aurora-v2/weights_shard_00-03.pt. can infra/ingest confirm path + checksum? also legal: any licensing blockers?

devon: got the s3 path, i'll run a checksum and kick the ingest job. expected shards 00..03?

maria.g: correct, 4 shards. sha256 manifest attached in the repo. pinging about tokenizer: model authors said it's SentencePiece with a custom unk/bos mapping. samir — any quick thoughts on tokenizer quirks?

samir: yeah quick note — their tokenizer uses sentencepiece with special BOS token id=1 (we usually expect 0). also they treat 1 as <s> and 2 as </s>. small change in tokenizer config needed: set bos_token_id to 1 and eos_token_id to 2, and add pad_token_id=0. otherwise KV cache alignment is off and streaming breaks.

samir: suggested config snippet:
```json
{
  "model_type": "transformer",
  "vocab_size": "50288",
  "bos_token_id": "1",
  "eos_token_id": "2",
  "pad_token_id": "0"
}
```

maria.g: perfect, i'll add that to the ingest manifest.

model-ingest-bot: ingest job started (job_id: j-aurora-20260317-7). status: queued -> staging.

devon: checksum OK on all shards. sizes: 6.4GB, 6.3GB, 6.3GB, 6.2GB. moving to staging bucket.

maria.g: legal — license header in the model card says "Research License v1.0" with a paragraph that forbids commercial use without separate agreement. is that a hard block for hosted API/dedicated?

jess.legal: thanks for the heads-up. "Research License v1.0" is non-commercial by default. two options: (1) we can't serve it on Hosted API (public/commercial) — could allow Private or Dedicated if customer signs a bespoke license and restricts usage, or (2) obtain a commercial grant from the upstream authors. For now, marking it as gated.

maria.g: OK — we'll mark upstream_license: "research-only" in the model meta and gate it from hosted tiers. Is an attribution clause present? authors require attribution + link back to model card.

jess.legal: yes attribution required. Add an attribution block to the model card and to the onboarding metadata: "attribution: \"Aurora v2 (AuthorName et al.), non-commercial, see model_card_url\"". Also log the license text and a pointer to legal thread.

devon: operational note — since it's gated, routing policy should default to private/dedicated and explicitly return 403 for hosted API calls. do we have a prebuilt policy for "research-only"?

samir: we have a gating flag in the ingestion pipeline: metadata.gate = ["no-hosted"]. runtime routing checks that flag. I can add an automated test to ensure hosted endpoints reject with proper error code and message.

maria.g: awesome. can someone add the following to the onboarding checklist before we flip status->ready: weights_checksum, tokenizer_config (as above), model_card with attribution + license text, gate flag set, and legal signoff comment.

jess.legal: i'll add the legal signoff note once we confirm there are no downstream consumer contracts that would conflict. expect a short follow-up by EOD.

devon: added gating policy and quick unit that asserts hosted returns 403 for requests with a hosted token. pushed to branch feat/aurora-ingest.

maria.g: thanks all — tracking in the ingest PR. i'll update the manifest and add a link to the model_card in the PR description. :thumbsup:
